ai.summary: OpenAI is reportedly seeking about $30 billion in a faster-than-usual fundraising round before Anthropic’s expected mid-November IPO, at a possible valuation above $1.4 trillion. Reuters says existing backers including SoftBank and MGX are in talks; the terms are not final.
ai.title: OpenAI seeks to accelerate fundraising ahead of Anthropic IPO, sources say

ai.summary: AI-cloud provider Modal plans to use Nvidia’s Vera central processors to host AI agents, adding Nvidia chips alongside its existing Intel and AMD fleet. Modal said early tests showed the Vera chip doubled the amount of work agents could complete; that result is the company’s own report.
ai.title: Nvidia wins fast-growing AI startup Modal for new central processors

ai.summary: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly discussing a cloud-computing deal that could be worth about $45 billion, involving a second facility at Nscale’s West Virginia data-center campus. Reuters could not independently verify the report, and the companies had not commented at publication.
ai.title: Nscale, Anthropic in talks for $45 billion cloud computing deal, Bloomberg News reports

ai.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang urged German manufacturers to adopt AI, arguing that digital technology can strengthen rather than replace the country’s industrial base. He made the appeal at an investment forum in Berlin alongside Chancellor Friedrich Merz.
ai.title: Nvidia CEO urges German manufacturers to adopt AI, saying digital tech won't replace heavy industry

ai.summary: Meta’s AI spending and adoption of its Muse assistant are in focus ahead of its quarterly results. The company is developing AI products and services as it seeks new revenue sources beyond advertising and invests heavily in infrastructure.
ai.title: Meta's AI spending, Muse assistant adoption in focus for quarterly results

ai.summary: OpenAI says its GPT-6 Astra scored 87.4% on a new 20-language coding evaluation, compared with 26.8% for GPT-5.6 Sol, and says it is releasing the MultiLangBench suite. These figures are reported from OpenAI’s evaluation and have not been independently verified in the available coverage.
ai.title: GPT-6 Astra scores 87.4% on OpenAI’s new 20-language SQLite coding evaluation

quantum.summary: Quantinuum reported that its Helios system reduced logical memory errors as it scaled a color code, reaching about five errors per million rounds with a 37-physical-qubit logical qubit. The result involved a single logical qubit, so scaling to many useful logical qubits remains a challenge.
quantum.title: A quantum computing feat brings the ‘megaquops’ era a step closer

quantum.summary: Alice & Bob reported operating three cat-qubit demonstrators—two 6-qubit chips and one 12-qubit chip—as part of France’s PROQCIMA program. The team demonstrated key error-correction components, but its measured logical error rate has not yet fallen below threshold.
quantum.title: Alice & Bob Reports Cat-Qubit Progress in French Quantum Computing Program

quantum.summary: At IEEE Quantum Week, Xanadu presented its Aurora photonic prototype, reporting that it ran continuously for more than a day. The system links 84 squeezers across 24 chips and uses light-based GKP qubits; the report also described a repetition-code decoding demonstration.
quantum.title: Quantum Error Correction Decoders At IEEE Quantum Week 2026

quantum.summary: Oxford researchers reported entanglement with 98% fidelity between two trapped-ion nodes, while other presentations highlighted the engineering costs of connecting separate quantum processors. The results underscore both progress in modular hardware and the difficulty of making interconnects fast enough for error correction.
quantum.title: Distributed Quantum Computing At IEEE Quantum Week 2026

quantum.summary: NVIDIA’s QCE 2026 presentation described CUDA-Q Logical, a compiler intended to map quantum programs through an error-correcting code and device layout to hardware control. The report also discussed resource estimates for a 2048-bit RSA factoring design, while noting that such estimates do not demonstrate a practical quantum attack.
quantum.title: Quantum HPC Integration At IEEE Quantum Week 2026

quantum.summary: Zapata Quantum appointed Peter Shor and three other researchers to its scientific advisory board, adding expertise in algorithms, error correction, quantum software and resource estimation. The company said the advisers will support the development of its Quantum Pilot platform and work on identifying potential applications.
quantum.title: Zapata Quantum Adds Peter Shor and Three Scientists to Advisory Board
